title: CAS here to stay, liquidity will pick up, says Sebi Chief
summary: Sebi chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated the closing auction session is here to stay.  He acknowledged initial liquidity concerns, which have improved in other markets.  Pandey mentioned Sebi will soon issue a consultation paper on the CAS framework.  Some market participants praised the implementation, especially during MSCI rebalancing events.  However, a segment of the market faces impacts due to settlement price dependency.

title: Canara Bank eyes $2 billion via overseas bonds
summary: Canara Bank intends to raise two billion dollars from international markets. This significant funding will be secured through its medium term note program. The bank plans to mobilize these funds via its Gift City branch. Senior unsecured foreign currency bonds will be issued for this purpose. This initiative aims to bolster the bank's overseas financial capabilities.

title: BSE tech glitch disrupts F&O trading on Sensex expiry day
summary: On Thursday, the BSE faced technical difficulties, leading to obstacles in executing trades related to futures and options during the crucial weekly Sensex expiry. According to the exchange, there was a short outage that affected specific segments of the cash market. Fortunately, normal operations resumed once the issue was addressed, although brokers reported similar disruptions on their trading platforms that were subsequently rectified.

title: NPA provisions fall for second straight quarter as bank asset quality improves
summary: Aggregate loan loss provisioning by banks dropped significantly year-on-year. This decline was driven by improving asset quality and fewer fresh slippages. Provision coverage ratios also reduced the need for fresh funds. Public sector banks saw a 19.8 percent fall in provisioning. Private sector banks registered a sharper 33.6 percent reduction in provisioning.

summary: On Thursday, Indian benchmark indices started with little movement, remaining in a narrow range as traders reacted to the elevated crude oil prices that dampened investor sentiment. title: Gujarat Fluorochemicals shares up 34% in 3 months: What’s driving the rally?
summary: The shares of Gujarat Fluorochemicals have experienced notable growth, driven by strong results from the June quarter. The company is gearing up for significant capital investments to broaden its reach in advanced fluoropolymers, strategically targeting booming markets like semiconductors and green hydrogen. Additionally, the shift towards battery materials is poised to act as a crucial source of growth, leading to enhanced earnings and returns in the near future.

title: Advent, Temasek in talks for Fairfax stake in IIFL Fin
summary: Advent International and Temasek Holdings are reportedly in talks to acquire Fairfax Financial's stake. Fairfax is looking to exit IIFL Finance as part of its IDBI Bank acquisition plan. This stake sale will help Fairfax comply with regulations and fund the IDBI Bank buyout. Fairfax currently holds a significant stake in IIFL Finance, which is valued at approximately ₹3,500 crore.

title: Canara HSBC Life fined Rs 1 crore for mis-selling policy to 88-yr-old via Canara Bank
summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company received a ₹1 crore penalty from IRDAI. The fine was imposed for mis-selling a deferred annuity policy to an 88-year-old individual. IRDAI identified several procedural and disclosure deficiencies in the sales process. The insurer subsequently refunded ₹4.09 lakh to the affected customer. This action highlights regulatory scrutiny over insurance sales practices.

title: 'Fintechs must treat data as fiduciary duty, not business asset,' says RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra
summary: Reserve Bank of India governor Sanjay Malhotra stressed data fiduciary responsibility for fintechs.  He stated that user data must be treated as a trustee asset, not a business asset.  Firms must use data strictly within user consent, protecting it diligently.  He warned that eroding trust through data misuse leads to irreversible damage.  Operational resilience and cybersecurity are essential for firms achieving significant scale.

title: SBI chief Setty says $127 billion FCNR inflow won’t trigger lending surge
summary: State Bank of India Chairman CS Setty addressed concerns regarding foreign currency deposit inflows. He stated these funds will be absorbed gradually over the coming months. The central bank's swap facility attracted significant foreign capital inflows. Commercial banks received substantial FCNR(B) deposits, exceeding market expectations. Setty also highlighted structural shifts towards asset tokenization in capital markets.

title: Global Fintech Fest 2026: PFRDA plans inflation-linked bonds to offer inflation-protected pension returns
summary: India's pension regulator is developing innovative bond issuances for inflation-protected returns.  Guidelines for these new products are expected within days, with rollout to follow soon.  The PFRDA is also working on a guaranteed-return scheme for non-government employees.  This initiative aims to provide more predictable retirement income for subscribers.  The regulator also plans to expand pension coverage among informal sector workers.

title: HDFC Bank says all seven Bahrain claims over Credit Suisse AT1 bonds rejected
summary: HDFC Bank has won all seven Bahrain cases filed by Credit Suisse AT1 bond investors, who accused the lender of mis-selling the risky securities. The Bahrain court rejected all allegations, saying investors failed to provide sufficient evidence linking HDFC Bank to their losses.
